subject: Request: IR evidence archive access + short-term retention clarification
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@blueharborhealth.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: security@blueharborhealth.com
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: retention window + access to archived IR evidence

Hi Vanessa,

Quick note following our incident sync: our compliance team needs an authoritative list of all artifacts you intend to retain from the 2026-10-26 auth anomaly (logs, telemetry extracts, sanitized packet captures). In particular:

- Confirm the retention window you plan to apply to the extracted evidence (we need at least 18 months for audit).
- Provide a secure temporary mechanism we can use to access the evidence for internal review (SFTP or ephemeral pre-signed URL).
- Send the preliminary evidence index and a small sample (sanitized) we can use to validate traceability.

Can you share the index and a link to the storage location by EOD today? If there's an internal contact we should work with for access, please loop them in.

Thanks,
Sanjay Rao
Head of InfoSec, BlueHarbor Health
security@blueharborhealth.com

Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -07:00

Marissa / Neha — forwarding BlueHarbor's ask. TL;DR: they want the evidence index, a sanitized sample, and confirmation of retention policy for the auth-anomaly artifacts. I told Sanjay I'd coordinate.

Action items:
- Marissa: prepare an "IR evidence index" CSV with artifact types, time ranges, retention tags, and owner. See example in SEC-482.
- Neha: produce a sanitized sample extract (auth logs) and package an auth-log-sample (.json.gz) that removes PII. Mark it for SFTP delivery.
- Karthik: confirm our short-term retention policy for extracted IR artifacts and whether we can commit to 18 months; if not, propose alternatives (encrypted escrow, customer-managed retention).

Also include a recommended temporary access method (we usually issue pre-signed S3 URLs with 5-day expiry and IP restriction; BlueHarbor asked for SFTP as an option). Please reply with the index + sample by 17:00 PT. I'll copy Sanjay once we have a link.

Thanks — V.

--
Vanessa Ortiz

vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0189

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Vanessa — attaching the first-pass index and a short playbook summary. Summary below; CSV and PDF attached to this thread (IR_evidence_index.csv, playbook-summary-v2.pdf).

Summary (for Sanjay):
- Evidence scope: auth logs (10/26–10/27), KV cache snapshots, agent telemetry snapshots, and trimmed request traces (redacted).
- Retention recommendation: default 12 months in hot storage + 6 months cold archive (total 18 months) — encrypted at rest with CMK. We can extend to 24 months with an escrow agreement; legal needs to sign an addendum.
- Access method: pre-signed S3 link (IP-restricted) for bulk download + short-lived SFTP user for BlueHarbor security (chrooted, 5-day credential).
- Sanitization: PII redaction applied; we can include hashed identifiers with mapping retained only in internal vault.

Neha — can you confirm the sample is redacted according to our PII guidance and produce auth-log-sample-20261027.json.gz? Also include MD5 and a small integrity manifest.

Vanessa — once you confirm, I'll upload to the secure bucket and issue the pre-signed link; I'll also create the SFTP account and share connection instructions via encrypted email.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Security Analyst, Redwood Inference
